findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
The generated-file proof still misses an existing starter generator. The scanner skips files other than JSON and Prisma files, so it never reads the Vite output directory configured in `src/forge/templates/starter/apps/web/vite.config.ts:18`; the web build runs Vite through `apps/web/project.json:18-22`. If that output is changed to `generated` and `apps/web/generated/index.html` is committed, a new app tracks the generated bundle while this test still passes.
Case: normal use - a starter change commits an output of the web build.
